faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Which interior design services do you offer in Chhattarpur?

We offer space planning, concept design, 3D views, working drawings, material and furniture selection, lighting design and site supervision for homes, farmhouses and commercial spaces.

Can I take only the design and use my own contractor?

Yes. You can take design and drawings only, or design with site supervision. We explain what each option includes before you decide.

How are your design fees worked out?

Fees depend on the size of the space, the scope of work and the level of detail. We share a clear proposal after the first meeting and site visit.

Why choose a full-service team for a farmhouse or large home?

Large homes have many rooms, services and vendors. Full interior design services keep drawings, materials and site work under one team, so quality stays the same across the house.
